description: B depends on A and overrides shared_calc, but A declares reads_shared after shared_calc and reads it as a prior result. B's override runs where B declares it, after all of A, so A's reader would have no value. The registry refuses the set rather than evaluate a silent null or schedule calculations across modules (RFC 0074 P3.1). Compare 07, where A's later calculation does not read shared_calc and the override loads. Listed before its dependency, B is refused by the existing dependency rule.
